rules.description: current_balance should not increase month-over-month unless modification_flag=1
days_past_due must be consistent with current_status band (e.g. Current=0, 90DPD>=60)
once a loan reaches Default or Prepaid, no subsequent row may show current_status=Current for the same loan without an explicit correction record
document_status should be 'Complete' when current_status is Default or Prepaid
current_balance and current_status reported by servicer_updates.csv should match the main panel within tolerance for the same loan_id/reporting_month
